editionStatus: Updated December 2021; listed on the current AAST technical-guidelines index
authorityBoundary: Primary current technologist workflow source for standard attended adult PSG, subordinate to current AASM scoring rules. The guideline does not address pediatric PSG, HSAT, or therapeutic PAP/oxygen titration and must not be used as authority for those pathways.
bestFor: Standard attended adult PSG preparation and monitoring, instrumentation, calibration, electrode preparation, recording quality, physiologic cross-correlation, artifact recognition, safety, technical documentation, and report-support workflow.

mappingRationale.D2A: Supports technical preparation for standard attended adult PSG and relevant physiologic/technical monitors.
mappingRationale.D2B: Directly addresses performance and monitoring of standard adult polysomnography.
mappingRationale.D2C: Addresses recording quality, physiologic correlation, artifact response, safety, and documentation under facility protocols.
mappingRationale.D3C: Supports the technologist documentation and report-support workflow while current AASM reporting rules remain controlling.

copyrightUse: Use document title, section headings, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial guideline text, tables, figures, or proprietary material.
